title: VoiceFlow feedback answer (voiceflow-feedback v1)
description: What a model must answer when the speaker gives feedback on one dictation: one JSON object, nothing else. Every field is present on every proposal (a field a type does not use is null or empty), so it works as strict structured output. The answer is untrusted: a client checks it as pack/feedback/README.md says before anyone sees it, and checks each proposal again against the word lists before it becomes an edit.

diagnosis.description: mishearing: speech-to-text got a word wrong. tidy-up-rewrite: tidy-up changed, dropped or added meaning. style-mismatch: the words are right but the tone or level is wrong for this app. delivery-privacy: about where or whether the text went (diagnosis only, no proposals). uncertain: not enough to go on (no proposals).

explanation.description: One plain sentence for the speaker.

corrected_text.description: The dictation as it should have been, for this one message. Empty: the delivered text stands.

proposals.description: Lasting fixes, at most three shown. spelling: always write these heard forms this way. style_adjust: for this app, a style and/or a step in expression. none: why no lasting fix is offered.

from.description: spelling: 1 to 5 heard forms, as they appear in the dictation.

scope.description: spelling: the model's suggestion; the speaker chooses. Anything else counts as app.

expression_delta.description: style_adjust: levels to move (negative: more reserved). 0 or null: leave the level.

style_id.description: style_adjust: a style id from the request's list, raw, or null to keep the style.
